title: Form 8995 — Qualified Business Income Deduction — 2024 computed line values
rationale: Form 8995 uses the simplified computation because 2024 MFJ taxable income before the QBI deduction ($293,400) is at or below the $383,900 threshold. The W-2 wage/UBIA limitation therefore does not apply; the deduction is the lesser of 20% of QBI ($36,000) or 20% of taxable income before the deduction ($58,680).
